coverage_note: 03:31-03:45 Medi lines garbled by engine (مهمتي, يا مهمني, بابا جان من ميرم بيته سريع, يومي كان مني) - not judged. 36:42-42:30 mostly Latin-transliterated (‹bindir balna›, ‹nakun ahel›, ‹fa'il›) - judged from the Latin. 32:07 'مناسبة' is most likely the engine for معصبة (Amal said Perfect after the 28:53 drill). 59:42 'الله يفيكي' = engine for الله يعافيكي. 18:54 'كم مرة الجملة' = kaman marra. 43:32 بنخط for بنخطط and 54:58-55:20 أزآن/أزأل for زهقان treated as S4 root-letter/pronunciation slips, not vocab. 07:45 تلاتة ونص -> تنتين ونص was a fact fix (wrong hour), not language. 33:57 he answered about himself (ما بأعمل إشي) when she asked what SHE does - comprehension, not filed. Echo candidate 19:07 'Uh-huh.' after احكي لي is real English, left as is. Repeated أطلبهم (20:20 as a question, 22:54 as a slip) filed once at 22:54.

rows.why: With إحنا the past verb needs the -na ending; Amal recast بدأنا and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: بدأنا a marketing project who who لازم اشتغلت كتير
rows.why: 'had to work a lot' needs kaan laazem + bare present; he used plain laazem + past; Amal recast and he repeated it.
rows.english: we started a marketing project which I had to work hard on

rows.why: The set reply to يعطيكم العافية is الله يعافيكي (he uses it correctly at 59:42); الله يوفقك is a different blessing. Reader's reading.
rows.english: reply to 'may God give you strength'

rows.why: مغني (singer) for مغيم (cloudy); Amal supplied مغيم and noted مغني is singer.
Subject is الجو (masc.), and Amal's own form was مغيم; he made it feminine and she let it pass.
In this idafa the owner noun takes el-; Amal recast درجة الحرارة and he used it next turn.
He said 18 for 80 (degrees F); Amal questioned تمنتاش؟ and he fixed to تمانين.
'approximately' is حوالي; حوالين means 'around/surrounding'. Reader's reading; Amal did not react.

rows.medi_said: ما زبت. زبت is... It means it's okay, right? It's positive.
rows.amal_said: ما زبت. It-- معنى it didn't work out.
rows.right: ما زبت = it didn't work out
rows.why: He could not give the meaning of her ما زبت and guessed the opposite; she supplied it.

rows.medi_said: الـ Google Meet، بقدر، understand. بقدر، آ-آآآ، تفهم-
rows.why: Google Meet is 'it' (masc.), so the verb is يفهم not تفهم; Amal recast and he took it.
Subject is Google Meet (it), so 'can' is بيقدر, not بقدر (I can); Amal fixed only تفهم.

rows.medi_said: يفهم عربي، بس ما، آآآم، م-م-ما، ما يقدر أكتب عربي.
rows.why: 'it can't write' = ما بيقدر يكتب; he used I-form أكتب and dropped the b- on يقدر; Amal let it pass.

rows.medi_said: هو راح، يأتي، راح ي-يأ-- ي-يأتينا-
rows.why: يأتي is formal MSA 'come'; for 'it will give us the translation' spoken would use يعطينا/يجيبلنا. Amal only echoed it. Reader's reading.
rows.english: it will give us the translation

rows.amal_said: تاني، تاني مشكلة or المشكلة التانية
rows.why: Adjective goes after the noun and el- goes on both (المشكلة التانية) or none before (تاني مشكلة); Amal asked شو التاني؟ then gave the forms and he repeated المشكلة التانية.

rows.medi_said: إنه احنا، نكتب في، Arabic or English letters.
rows.why: After إنه the present verb keeps b- (B3: enno keeps it): بنكتب. Amal let it pass.
rows.english: that we write in Arabic or English letters

rows.medi_said: That's been، I don't remember. أنا ما بـ-- ما، ما بتذكر، هذي الكلمة.
rows.amal_said: فترة means while, a while or period of time.
rows.why: He said he did not remember فترة; Amal supplied the meaning.

rows.medi_said: So what, what makes you sad at this time?
rows.why: He read تعب as 'sad'; Amal corrected to 'tired'.
rows.english: what tires you most these days

rows.medi_said: هو، هما ما، ما، ما يخلصوا.
rows.why: Habitual present 'they don't finish' needs b- (he says ما بيخلصوا at 22:48); Amal only echoed يخلصوا.
He means every day (keep asking them daily); kul + el- = the whole day, every day is كل يوم. Amal let it pass.
rows.english: every day I have to ask them

rows.medi_said: أنا بتعب كتير لما عيلتنا-- عيلتي، اللي، أشتغل معهم. و هو...
rows.why: He means the family members (they); Amal supplied هما and he used it.
After illi the present keeps b- (no drop word): اللي بشتغل معهم. Amal let it pass.
rows.english: my family that I work with

rows.why: He used the verb (I worked them) where the noun شغل + -hom is needed; Amal recast شغلهم and he repeated it.
طلب takes من for the person asked; Amal had taught أطلب منهم at 20:48 and fixed it again here; he repeated أطلب منهم.

rows.medi_said: أطلب منهم كتير إنو، يخلص، يخلصهم؟
rows.why: They (plural) finish it (the work, singular): يخلصوه; he gave a singular verb with a plural object; Amal recast and he said 'you're right'.
'for a long time' is لوقت طويل; زمان means long ago / old times; Amal recast and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: خطيبتي ما، ما بتضل... بتضل تعصب
rows.amal_said: خطيبتي ما بتضل تعصب. ... So it's angry, not to get angry. It's the adjective.
rows.why: After ضل 'stay angry' needs the state word معصبة, not the verb تعصب; Amal explained it and he produced معصب(ة) at 28:45. B15 is not taught yet - shown, not counted.
rows.english: my fiancee doesn't stay angry for long

rows.medi_said: it's أنا بـ بنزبط. Is it b- بنزبطها؟
rows.why: For 'I make her happy' he reached for زبط (fix) in the we-form; Amal gave ببسطها and said 'we did a lot' (known word).

rows.medi_said: أنا أعمل، ب- أ- أ- أعمل؟ بـ... أعمل. أعمل غلط.
rows.amal_said: أنا, I did something wrong. What's I made-
rows.why: 'I did something wrong' needs past عملت; Amal prompted in English, confirmed عملت, and he said أنا عملت إشي غلط.
Subject is his fiancee, so the adjective is feminine معصبة; Amal recast and he repeated.
'I apologize' is the t-verb بتأسف, not ba+آسف; Amal said 'Very close' and he reached بتأسف at 30:00, which she confirmed.

rows.medi_said: لما أنا بأعمل غلط، إشي غلط.
rows.why: lamma drops the b- on the next verb (لما أعمل); he kept it and Amal let it pass.
He is talking about his fiancee (she), not to Amal; she supplied هي and he said 'sorry. هي'.
'a long time' is وقت طويل; Amal said لا and gave طويل, he repeated it.
He used 'we look at' for 'we babysit'; Amal questioned it and gave bindir balna 3ala (sheet: 'i take care of | Ana badir baali').
Wrong vowel pattern of دار/يدير for 'we take care'; Amal recast Bindir and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: ooh, I wanna say both of us. Do I just say ‹tinen›? Or-
rows.why: He asked how to say 'both of us'; Amal supplied ahna il tinen.

rows.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?
rows.amal_said: Oh, here ‹hala ma btihtaj min›. ‹Bin khaf nakun›.
rows.why: No min before a verb: بنخاف نكون أهل; Amal said here you don't need min and he repeated bin khaf nikun.

rows.medi_said: ‹Ana lazim, astamel il fa'il›, instead, instead is... Oh my God.
rows.amal_said: Oh, we don't know instead. No, no. Don't worry. ‹Badal›.
rows.why: He could not say 'instead'; Amal supplied badal.
Wrong form of اسم (noun); sheet 'noun – nouns | Esem | اسم'; Amal recast Ism and he repeated it.
'we plan to be parents' needs the we-form نكون; Amal recast and he fixed it.

rows.medi_said: على كلٍ. على كلٍ شو، اه، شو، اه، بعصب، بعصب. I'm asking you.
rows.amal_said: But if you want to say, you would say بشكل عام.
rows.why: He asked whether على كل (Farsi-style) works for 'in general'; Amal said it sounds wrong and gave بشكل عام.
3ashaan drops the b-; Amal recast أعصب and he asked 'عشان gets rid of be?'

rows.medi_said: ولا إشي، ولا إشي بيعص-- بعصبني
rows.why: Subject is ولا إشي (it), so the verb is بيعصبني, not the I-form بعصبني; Amal recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: She doesn't get-- هي ما، ما تعصب
rows.why: Plain present needs b-; Amal recast بتعصب and he said هي ما بتعصب.

rows.medi_said: هي ما بتعصب، آآآه، سهل كمان
rows.why: سهل (easy) for 'quickly'; Amal said 'Quickly' in English and he switched to بسرعة.

rows.amal_said: Well, that's not the same meaning. هذا مش نفس المعنى بالعربي ... a good word for this would be رايق
rows.why: He used مظلوم (Farsi sense 'calm') which in Arabic means 'oppressed'; Amal said it's not the same meaning and gave رايق.

rows.medi_said: زهآن. زهآن. بس، آه، لما بزهأ.
rows.why: lamma drops the b-; Amal recast لما أزهأ and he repeated it.
Plain present answer needs b- (sheet: 'i change scenery | Ba8ayyer jaw'); Amal recast بغير and he said بغير.
rows.english: I get a change of scenery

rows.why: Fixed phrase بغير جو has no el-; Amal recast at 58:21 then said 'No ال' at 58:24 (he repeated الجو at 58:22 and 58:26).

rows.medi_said: أنا بظن إنه، عملنا كتير. عملنا-
rows.why: عمل needs what was done; Amal asked شو عملنا؟ twice and he said عملنا تمرين كتير.
rows.english: we did a lot of practice

rows.why: 'a lot of exercises' takes the plural تمارين; Amal let it pass (her عنجد؟ reacts to the content).
rows.english: we did a lot of exercises
